reason: Defects in the proposed falsifier. (1) Metric: 'max degree' is the F4 degree in two rings of different dimension. B has about 3l+3n bit-variables (x bits 3l, chart a1,a2 2n, Veronese cross term a1*a2 n; a_i^2 is F_2-linear in char 2) against about 3l for A. Input degree of B is already 3 (e_3 cubic in bits), so 'degree <=4' is near-tautological and is bought by variable blow-up, which is the stated HKYY risk. Degree alone cannot separate advance from relabelling; matrix size (columns ~ C(V,D)) must be the metric. (2) No null arm and no variable-matched control. Needed: A plus the same number of auxiliary Veronese-style product variables. If A-plus-aux also drops to degree <=4, B is relabelling. (3) 'n-independent Eagon-Northcott resolution' is a statement over F_{2^n}. After Weil descent d_reg scales as n*d_reg-n+1 (CCG Prop 4.13, checked by falldeg_weil_dreg_check.py), so the n-independence does not transfer to the bit system. (4) The diagonal l~n/m confounds n with l. Known m=3 baseline D=ceil(l/2)+4 rises with l alone; n=13..21 gives 3 distinct l values-ish and cannot tell bounded from slow growth (PKM shows plateaus 6,6,7,7). A one-sided kill only: B growing like A establishes relabelling; B flat on 13..21 does not establish boundedness. (5) Chart: a is projective, so without fixing a chart (a_0=1) the system is positive-dimensional (2^n-1 scalings) and solution counts cannot agree; the chart loses about 2^-n of solutions. (6) Solution-count agreement is only meaningful on SAT targets; with l=floor(n/3) most targets are UNSAT, so stratify and for UNSAT compare refutation degree. msolve char 2 needs -g 1/2 and v^2+v appended, and the count is read from the staircase of the leading ideal. (7) Runnability: no generator exists for B; q_k(a) in char 2 for y^2+xy=x^3+a2x^2+a6 must be derived and checked on enumerated points (n=13: 8k points, gp). 9 n-values x 2 l x 20 targets x 2 arms = 720 msolve runs, so about 1.6 s each against 20 CPU-min. B at n>=17 (V about 70-90 bit vars, degree 4-5 gives 10^6-10^7 columns) will not finish. Needs per-run caps and censoring. (8) Scaling: toy says nothing about n=131 except through a counted-monomial extrapolation. B at n=131 has V about 520 bit variables; C(520,4) is about 2^31.5 columns, C(520,5) about 2^38. Sparse linear algebra at dim 2^31.5 is already about 2^63 or more, against rho 2^64.9 (back-of-envelope, unverified). So even a constant degree 4 gives at best a constant factor, not an exponent change. The CGK certificate B*D^2<<N is not addressed by the idea. Expected class stays relabelling/engineering.
fix: Redesign. ARMS: (A) descended S_4 (ic corpus --degree n --dimension l, .anf to msolve; also ic descent for D_GB labels). (B) fibre-Veronese system with chart a_0=1, variables x-bits (3l), a1,a2 bits (2n), v12=a1*a2 bits (n), equations e_k(x)=q_k(a) descended to F_2 plus minors (v11*v22=v12^2) plus v^2+v. (A+) A with the same number of auxiliary product variables (w_ij=x_i*x_j bits, plus n dummy chart-like linear variables) as the variable-count control. (Bnull) B with random cross-term constants in q_k, same shape, as the structural null; also ffd_semaev_core.random_matched for A. (P) positive control: reproduce measured m=3 A baseline D=ceil(l/2)+4 at l=4..8. CORRECTNESS GATE before any timing: for n=13 enumerate all E(F_{2^13}) points with gp, check for every triple with P1+P2+P3=R that e_k(x)=q_k(a) for the a from L(2O+R), and that B-solution count equals A-solution count (read from the staircase of -g 1 leading ideal) on SAT targets; abort if mismatch. GRID: off-diagonal, n in {13,15,17,19,21} x l in {floor(n/3)-1..floor(n/3)+1}, 10 targets (>=5 SAT, rest UNSAT, stratified), per-run cap 20 s, total cap 20 CPU-min, timeouts recorded as censored (not failures). METRICS (counted, not wall time): V=#bit-vars, input degree, msolve -v 2 max F4 deg, max matrix rows x cols, cumulative nnz (density*size), log2 C(V,D) monomial count, refutation degree for UNSAT, SAT/UNSAT solution counts. Wall time kept as a secondary column only. DECISION RULE (pre-registered): B is distinguished from relabelling iff (i) B max deg <=4 on all uncensored cells, (ii) A+ (variable-matched) has max deg >=5 on cells where B has <=4, (iii) log2 cols_B <= log2 cols_A at n=21 or the cols_B growth in n is no steeper than A's, and (iv) Bnull does not also show <=4. Otherwise label relabelling. SCALING STEP: with the observed D_B, extrapolate log2 C(V_B(n),D_B) to n=131 (V about 4n) and compare to rho 2^64.9 and to the CGK line B*D^2 vs N; report as an upper-bound sanity check only. A flat B on n<=21 is NOT evidence of boundedness; only B-grows-like-A is a valid kill.
